title: Forward Deployed Engineer
summary: Senior AI Engineer with 8+ years building and operating production ML and LLM systems, often working directly with clients to turn their requirements into shipped software. Builds agentic applications with LangGraph and tool orchestration, production RAG with embeddings, vector stores and reranking, and document-extraction agents integrated with enterprise systems, all with evaluation, tracing and observability. Ships through FastAPI, REST APIs, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform and Azure. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Field Service Scheduling Agent
bullets: Built an agentic assistant for field service operations that reads work orders, checks technician availability through REST APIs exposed as MCP tools, and drafts schedules using RAG over maintenance manuals.
Evaluated tool-call accuracy and retrieval quality with LLM evaluators and tracing, then deployed on Azure Kubernetes Service with Docker, Terraform and monitoring fed by real usage.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Forward Deployed Engineer role at IFS. As a Senior AI Engineer I build agentic applications, RAG systems and document-extraction agents that run in production, and much of my career has been spent in front of clients working out what they really need. The thread is turning a messy operational problem into a working system quickly.

IFS builds the systems that run field service, scheduling and maintenance for industries like telecom, where I spent several years, so the problems feel familiar. Embedding with customers and shipping in weeks is how I like to work. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to London together and settle there long term.

I would bring two things. At Viavi I prototyped 15+ AI applications straight from client requirements, and 7 moved into production or paid work. At Optum I shipped a lab-extraction agent integrated with an existing LIMS that handles about 1,800 documents, with evaluation and tracing to keep it reliable.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. Working with teachers taught me to sit with users before building anything, the same habit this role needs. I would be glad to talk about how I could help IFS customers.
